title: Remove temporary Relationship Analyzer diagnostics
purpose: 会話や記憶・関係性を扱う処理の変更
purpose_basis: 変更パスと表題による分類（意味の確定には原文を確認）
body:
Production verification is complete. This cleanup removes only the temporary Analyzer stage/reason diagnostics introduced during recovery.

Keeps unchanged:
- Gemini polarity STRING enum ["-1","1"] transport
- immediate normalization to numeric ±1
- strict parseEvidence() validation
- filtering of evidence whose supportingTurn is not an exact user-message substring
- DB / lease / retry / state / critical-event contracts

No environment or database changes.
